newsitem.title: USA: Arhur J. Gallagher forms financial unit.
newsitem.headline: Arhur J. Gallagher forms financial unit.

text.p: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co said Tuesday it is forming a new subsidiary designed to expand the parent company's strategic investment alternatives.
The new unit, Arthur J. Gallagher Financial Services Inc, will focus on direct management of the parent firm's investment portfolio in addition to development of new business lines, the company said.
Arthur J. Gallagher provides risk management services to clients seeking alternatives to traditional commercial insurance products.
Its shares were trading off 1/4 Tuesday at 31-3/4.
